content:
One MKBHD video still moves more hardware than most paid campaigns combined.

---

That's not a content strategy insight. That's a distribution reality check.

The brands winning in consumer tech aren't outspending — they're out-seeding. One authentic review > seven banner ads.

---

If you're building a hardware product and influencer seeding isn't in your launch playbook, you're not late. You're already behind.

Who's doing creator-led distribution right outside of tech? I want examples.
source_story_title: MKBHD Reviews Galaxy Buds 4 Pro: Better Than Expected
source_story_summary: Top tech YouTuber Marques Brownlee (@MKBHD) published a new video reviewing Samsung's Galaxy Buds 4 Pro, signaling a positive verdict with the framing 'better than you think.' The review comes from one of the most influential voices in consumer tech media, with the post garnering notable engagement shortly after posting.
